_meta.requested: t549u-t550u (motion + tempo must match real lifters, credible free sources)

angle_conventions.space: 2D image-plane angles from the cached 13-point keypoints (sh, sh_r/l, elb_r/l, wr_r/l, hip_r/l, kn_r/l, ank_r/l). 3/4 camera views foreshorten angles, so every check has a tolerance (tol_deg).
angle_conventions.hip_flexion: 180 - angle(shoulder, hip, knee); 0 = standing straight, negative not measurable in 2D (treat <=0 as extended)
angle_conventions.arm_torso: angle(hip, shoulder, elbow); 0 = arm at the side, 90 = horizontal (abduction / flexion), 180 = overhead
angle_conventions.trunk_from_vertical: angle between mid-hip->mid-shoulder and straight up; 0 = upright, 90 = horizontal
angle_conventions.thigh_below_horizontal: angle of hip->knee below horizontal; >0 = hip lower than knee (below parallel)
angle_conventions.knee_ankle_width_ratio: |knee_r.x - knee_l.x| / |ankle_r.x - ankle_l.x| (valgus proxy, front/3-4 view only)

_meta.views: items with `view` (e.g. 'top' = camera above/in front of a lying lifter) are only valid in that camera view; in the reels' 3/4 view the 2D angle is not the anatomical one, so motion_check reports them as n/a unless view= matches
_meta.stats: start = first frame, end = last frame, min/max/range over the step, value = metric at the frame where `at.metric` hits `at.extreme`
_meta.basis: source = the number comes from the cited source; heuristic = the cited source describes the cue but gives no number, so the threshold is a pipeline tolerance (change freely)

general_tempo.note: General hypertrophy tempo: ACSM moderate velocity 1-2 s CON / 1-2 s ECC; 0.5-8 s per rep gives similar growth (Schoenfeld 2015, Enes 2025), >10 s per rep likely worse. Trained lifters self-select reps shorter than a strict 2:2 (Nobrega 2018).

schoenfeld2015.title: Schoenfeld, Ogborn, Krieger 2015, Sports Med: repetition duration and hypertrophy meta-analysis (0.5-8 s similar; >10 s likely inferior)

enes2025.title: Enes ... Schoenfeld 2025, JSCR 39(12): How Slow Should You Go? tempo meta-analysis (ECC 0.25-4.5 s, CON 0.5-4.5 s; faster vs slower similar)

acsm2009.title: ACSM Position Stand 2009: Progression models in resistance training (moderate velocity 1-2 s CON, 1-2 s ECC; hypertrophy 6-12 RM at moderate velocity)

nobrega2018.title: Nobrega et al. 2018, JSCR: self-selected vs fixed 2 s/2 s repetition duration in trained men (fixed 2:2 had longer TUT per rep than self-selected)

acsm_hfj_tempo2023.title: ACSM's Health & Fitness Journal 2023: The Ultimate Guide for Selecting Repetition Tempos (hypertrophy 0.5-8 s per rep)

rodriguez_ridao2020.title: Rodriguez-Ridao et al. 2020, IJERPH: five bench inclinations EMG (upper pec max at 30 deg; >45 deg shifts to anterior deltoid; protocol 2 s ECC / 2 s CON)

sbs_bench.title: Stronger by Science, How to Bench Press (upper arm-torso angle ~45-60 deg; low incline 15-30 deg; grip 1.5-2x shoulder width)

noteboom2024.title: Noteboom et al. 2024, Front Physiol: bench press technique variations and shoulder loads (abduction 45/70/90 deg, grip 1-2 BAW)

cscca_squat.title: CSCCA Back Squat technique (femur parallel depth; common errors knee valgus, heels rising, chest dropping)

scj2018_squat.title: Strength & Conditioning Journal 2018: Optimizing Squat Technique Revisited (full depth 115-125 deg knee flexion, knees over toes, no valgus)

scj2020_lowbar.title: Strength & Conditioning Journal 2020: Technical Aspects of the Low-Bar Back Squat (tops of thighs just below parallel; excess depth -> forward lean / posterior pelvic tilt)

myer2014_squat.title: Myer et al. 2014, The Back Squat Part 2 (correcting knee valgus etc.)

lee2018_rdl.title: Lee et al. 2018, J Exerc Sci Fit: EMG and kinetic comparison of conventional and Romanian deadlifts (RDL peak hip flexion 80.0+/-15.9 deg, knee 33.9+/-12.6 deg; RDL knee 15-33 deg)

ace_rdl.title: ACE ProSource: Romanian Deadlift technique guide

ace_pushdown.title: ACE Exercise Library: Triceps Pushdowns (elbows by sides, torso vertical, extend fully without locking, pause momentarily)

ace_pulldown.title: ACE Exercise Library: Seated Lat Pulldown (lean back no more than 30 deg, no additional lean during pull, bar to top/mid chest, scapulae depressed)

signorile2002.title: Signorile et al. 2002, JSCR: EMG of hand positions in the lat pull-down (wide grip anterior highest lat activity)

pulldown2025.title: 2025 J Funct Morphol Kinesiol: lat pulldown grip variations incl. 30 deg trunk inclination (no lat EMG difference; more posterior deltoid)

ace_lateral.title: ACE Exercise Library: Lateral Raise (slight elbow bend, raise until arms level with shoulders ~parallel to floor, no low-back arch / shrug)

coratella2020.title: Coratella et al. 2020, IJERPH: EMG of lateral raise variations in bodybuilders (abduct to 90 deg; protocol 2 s CON / 2 s ECC / 0.5 s isometric)

ace_barbell_row.title: ACE Total-body Barbell Workout: bent-over row (torso about 45-90 deg from vertical / almost parallel; hold contraction for a second)

acsm_hfj_row2017.title: ACSM's Health & Fitness Journal 2017: The Barbell Row Exercise

jstage_row.title: J-STAGE (Japan J Coaching/Training): trunk flexion angle 40 vs 65 deg in bent-over row EMG

issa_ohp.title: ISSA: Overhead Press proper form and common mistakes (bar aligned with ears at lockout, no lower-back arch, straight bar path)

scj2017_ohp.title: Strength & Conditioning Journal 2017: Exploring the Standing Barbell Overhead Press

contreras_ht.title: Bret Contreras: How to Hip Thrust (shins vertical at lockout)

contreras_scoop.title: Bret Contreras 2022: Hip Thrust Hinge vs Scoop (hip hyperextension ~10-15 deg past neutral with bent legs; avoid spinal overarch)

contreras2015_emg.title: Contreras et al. 2015, J Appl Biomech: glute max EMG back squat vs barbell hip thrust

ace_legpress.title: ACE Exercise Library: Seated Leg Press (knees ~90 deg at setup, sacrum flat on backrest, no low-back movement, don't lock knees)

legpress_rom2025.title: 2025 J Sports Sci: knee flexion ROM (~5-100 vs ~5-154 deg) does not change quad hypertrophy in leg press

ace_curl.title: ACE: 4 Upper-body Movements for Beginners - Biceps Curl (elbows close to sides, straight body line)

ace_seated_row.title: ACE Exercise Library: Seated Row (torso vertical, avoid leaning back / arching, elbows past sides, pause momentarily)

acsm_hfj_seated_row.title: ACSM's Health & Fitness Journal 2019: Do It Right: The Seated Cable Row Exercise

bss2025.title: 2025 EMG study: Bulgarian split squat trunk position (upright: back knee to floor ~100-110 deg front knee flexion; forward trunk lean raises glute max)

scj2017_rfess.title: Strength & Conditioning Journal 2017: Technique, Variation, and Progression of the Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat

ffpa_pfp.title: 2023 IJSPT: frontal plane projection angle cutoff 8.2 deg (single-leg squat, women with patellofemoral pain; NOT a universal threshold)
